Let me walk through the 24-hour grace benefit first, since it takes precedence. Condition A, elapsed time since purchase: the booking was created November 6 at 12:00 UTC, and our current business time is also November 6 at 12:00 UTC, so zero hours have elapsed — that condition is met. Because both conditions must be satisfied, the grace-period full refund does not apply here.

So we fall back to the flexible fare's voluntary cancellation rule. A flexible fare cancelled before departure gets the unused ticket value back to the original payment method with no cancellation fee. That would be USD 349.00 back to your original payment method, and any refundable unused taxes would be returned separately — though I don't have a tax breakdown established, so I can't quote a tax figure.

Thanks, Jordan — I've got your booking on DEMO301, San Francisco to New York, departing Monday November 9 at 6:30 am local.

Here's the cabin pet policy. Cats and dogs at least 12 weeks old can travel in the cabin on domestic flights, and SFO to JFK qualifies. One pet per carrier, one carrier per passenger, and the pet plus carrier together must weigh no more than 8 kg. The carrier can be at most 45 by 30 by 23 cm, must fit under the seat, and needs to be ventilated, leak-resistant and securely closed. It replaces your carry-on, though you can still bring one personal item. The pet must stay inside the closed carrier under the seat for the whole flight.

The fee is 125 US dollars per carrier, per direction, and it covers connecting segments in the same direction on the same ticket. A return trip would be a separate fee. Requests are recommended at least 48 hours before departure, and each flight takes a maximum of four pet carriers, so pet space has to be confirmed separately from your ticket — available passenger seats don't confirm a pet space.

On timing: your departure is about 74 and a half hours from now, so you're comfortably past the 48-hour recommended notice.

Before I submit the request, I need a few details. What is your cat's age, and what are the carrier's dimensions and the combined weight of your cat and the carrier?

Thanks, Avery. My cat is 2 years old. The cat plus soft carrier weighs 6 kg total, and the carrier measures 40 by 30 by 20 cm. Please go ahead and submit the request for the pet on booking E6297E6DC7, but I want the submission confirmed before I'm charged the fee of 125 US dollars. Can you confirm the request is submitted and whether it's approved?
